senses.gloss: (denom. of מֶלֶט, v. מַלְטֵט) the casings for the beams in wall openings.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 6a:9">B. Bath. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>אע״ג דמנח ביה המלטא</he> Ar. (ed. Koh. <he>הַמְלָטָה</he>, Ms. M. <he>דמתנח ביה חמולט׳</he>, ed. <he>דעביד ליה הימלטי</he>) although he placed sills thereon (intimating that the neighbor may in future rest beams on them). V. <cite ref="M02094"><he>מַעֲזִיבָה</he></cite>.
